info.name: Stashly API v1
info.description:
Stashly REST API (Laravel 12), base path `/api/v1`. All **33 operations** (the API reference's 32 plus Google sign-in, DEC-035), grouped by domain, with automated tests, request chaining and saved example responses.

**Quick start**
1. Import this collection and *Stashly Local* environment, select the environment.
2. Run `php artisan serve` (default `http://localhost:8000`).
3. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner): *Register* stores `bearer_token`, *Create link* stores `link_id`, *Create collection* stores `collection_id`.

**Conventions:** JSON, `snake_case`, ULIDs, UTC timestamps. Success bodies are `{"data": ...}`; errors are `{"error": {"code", "message", "details", "request_id"}}` - branch on `code`. Auth is a Bearer token inherited from the collection; public requests set *No Auth*.

**Provisional shapes** (not yet confirmed by the Android owner): see `Stashly_Backend_Docs/api/android-contract-review.md`.

Destructive requests (Logout, Delete account, Delete link) and Reset password are skipped unless enabled (`run_destructive`, `reset_token`).

variable.description: API base URL including the /api/v1 prefix.
Access token. Set automatically by Register, Login and Refresh.
ULID of the working link. Set by Create link.
UNUSED: tags have no ids in this API (they are identified by name); see tag_name. Kept empty as requested.
UNUSED: the export is a single synchronous download with no export id. Kept empty as requested.
ULID of the working collection. Set by Create collection.
Name of the working tag. Set by Set link tags.
E-mail of the test account. Generated by Register.
ULID of the test account. Set by Register.
Current password of the test account. Managed by Register and Change password.
Password used by Register (test account only; not a real credential).
Password used by Change password and Reset password (test account only).
Paste the token from the reset e-mail to enable Reset password.
Set to true to run Logout, Delete account and Delete link (they break the chain for later requests).
Paste a fresh Google ID token (expires in about an hour) to enable Sign in with Google.

item.name: 02 - Authentication & Session
item.description:
Account lifecycle and the signed-in user. Contract: API-AUTH-001..008 (008 = Google sign-in, DEC-035), API-PROF-001, 002, 003, 005.

**Order matters:** run *Register* (or *Login*) first - it stores `bearer_token`, which every protected request in the collection then uses. *Logout*, *Delete account* and *Reset password* are skipped unless explicitly enabled (see their descriptions) because they would invalidate the token used by later folders.

request.description:
**API-AUTH-008 (DEC-035)** - Signs in, links or registers with a Google ID token obtained on Android (Credential Manager / Google Sign-In) and returns the same `{user, token}` as *Login*. Public. Rate limit: 10/minute per IP. Stores `bearer_token`.

- **Existing Google user** → `200`.
- **Existing account with the same (Google-verified) e-mail** → the Google account is linked, that account's older tokens are revoked **and its password is cleared** (DEC-037; set a new one through forgot-password), `200` with `password_set: false`.
- **New user** → `201`; `terms_accepted` must be `true` (otherwise `422 VALIDATION_FAILED`).
- Bad, expired or wrong-audience token, or an unverified Google e-mail → `401 INVALID_GOOGLE_TOKEN`. `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` when `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` is not configured (`GET /config` reports `auth.google_enabled`).

**Skipped unless the variable `google_id_token` is set** - paste a fresh ID token (they expire after about an hour). The app never needs the user's Google password; the token is never logged by the server.

Body: `id_token*`, `device_name*` (max 255), `terms_accepted` (required for a new account), `terms_version`.

response.name: 200 OK - existing or newly linked account
401 Unauthorized - invalid, expired or wrong-audience token
401 Unauthorized - Google e-mail not verified
422 Unprocessable Entity - new account without accepted terms
429 Too Many Requests - 10 per minute per IP
503 Service Unavailable - Google sign-in not configured

request.description:
**API-PROF-005 (DEC-036)** - Permanently deletes the account and all its data. `204 No Content`.

- Account **with a password** (`user.password_set = true`): body `{"password": ...}`; `422` on a wrong password.
- **Google-only account** (`password_set = false`): body `{"id_token": ...}` - a fresh Google ID token for the linked Google account. `401 INVALID_GOOGLE_TOKEN` when it is invalid, expired or belongs to another Google account; `503` when Google's keys cannot be reached.

**Skipped unless `run_destructive` = `true`.**

response.name: 422 Unprocessable Entity - wrong password
401 Unauthorized - Google-only account, invalid or foreign id_token

item.name: 04 - Links Management
item.description:
The user's saved links. Contract: API-LINK-002..008. Ownership: another user's link is always `404 NOT_FOUND`.

*Create link* stores `link_id`; Show / Update / the relation requests use it. *Delete link* is skipped unless `run_destructive` = `true` so the link stays available to the folders after this one.

item.name: 06 - Tags & Organization
item.description:
Tags and collections. **Tags have no ids and no create/update/delete endpoints** - they are identified by name and managed through *Set link tags* (folder 04); `GET /tags` lists them. Collections have full CRUD plus an atomic attach/detach. Contract: API-TAG-001, API-COLL-001..006.
